method: Descriptive Arabic-token counts with combining marks removed for matching only. Original text preserved. No dependency parser, word alignment or inference of universal grammar rules. Counts overlap.

copula_or_auxiliary.interpretation: Copula/auxiliary family. Exact inflection and agreement need context.

limitations: Corpus vocabulary is heavily encyclopedic and software-interface language.
Punctuation segmentation can misalign translations despite owner approval.
Raw tokens are not dictionary lemmas, bilingual word meanings or grammatical tags.
No defensible word-order percentages or tense/gender labels can be obtained from these token counts alone.
Apparent alignment issues require review before using examples as authoritative grammar.
